note: vespera_macro (round-19 parser audit): a path segment of type Option<T> (struct field, tuple element, collection element, bare argument, value_type) is typed as T, never nullable, since serde reads a segment as Some; a query flatten chain keys its recursion guard by the resolved definition, so two same-named structs in one chain are both read; a local glob import (use crate::models::*;) of a same-named struct stops the crate-wide return-alias lookup, and only src/lib.rs / src/main.rs is the crate root; an internally tagged enum variant skipped in only one direction is still validated; Cow<str> payloads are rejected like Box<str>; several error bodies on one status (400) are documented as oneOf; generic substitution covers qualified self types, associated-type bindings and T::Out; unbalanced regex groups, brackets, braces and trailing backslashes are not documented as ECMA patterns; generic instance names are injective for module-qualified types, qualified self types and array length expressions; HasOne / BelongsTo fallback is nullable like the entity arm (sea-orm serializes unloaded relations as null); doc and test fixes.
